concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-payment-methods-venmo]] - Venmo checkout and vaulting route with unsupported-business-model, US-entity, SDK-version, customer-version, production-profile and 180-day refund qualifications from the collected guide
warnings: Keep this Braintree Venmo route distinct from PayPal checkout, in-person collection, peer-to-peer transfers and receiving payment through the Venmo app.
Preserve page-scoped SDK, app, OS and eligibility wording; the 2026-09-16 collection snapshot does not prove current support, customer eligibility or merchant enablement.
Do not turn Sandbox setup or a production-profile application into approval, tokenization, authorization, settlement or refund-success evidence.
